description:
The Family Pension Scheme under the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (DBOCWWB) is a significant welfare initiative aimed at providing financial security to the families of construction workers in Delhi.

The scheme was officially launched on 1st April 2018. 

It was introduced to address the financial needs of the dependents of construction workers who may pass away due to work-related accidents or other unforeseen circumstances.

The primary objective of the Family Pension Scheme is to ensure that the families of deceased construction workers receive a regular income to support their livelihood.

The scheme aims to provide a monthly pension to the eligible dependents of registered construction workers.

The targeted beneficiaries include the spouse and children of the deceased construction worker.

The monthly pension amount is set at ₹3,000.

This pension is intended to provide a safety net for families who may face financial difficulties after the loss of their primary breadwinner.

To be eligible for the Family Pension Scheme, the deceased construction worker must have been registered with the DBOCWWB at the time of their death.

The worker must have contributed to the welfare fund for a minimum of 12 months prior to their demise.

The applicant for the pension must be the legal heir of the deceased worker.

The legal heir must provide proof of relationship to the deceased worker.

The applicant must also provide a death certificate of the deceased worker.

Additionally, the applicant must submit proof of identity and address.

The application process involves several steps.

First, the applicant must obtain the application form from the DBOCWWB office or download it from the official website.

The completed application form must be submitted along with the required documents.

The documents should include the death certificate of the worker, proof of identity, proof of relationship, and proof of address.

Once the application is submitted, it will be reviewed by the officials at the DBOCWWB.

The processing time for the application is typically 30 days from the date of submission.

If the application is approved, the pension will be disbursed to the eligible dependents.

The pension is paid on a monthly basis.

The disbursement is made directly to the bank account of the eligible family member.

In terms of frequency, the pension is disbursed on the first week of every month.

The DBOCWWB is responsible for implementing this scheme.

The board operates under the Delhi Government's Labour Department.

The contact details for the DBOCWWB are available on their official website.

The board can be reached through their helpline number which is +91-11-2337-5000.

The Family Pension Scheme is part of a broader initiative to support the welfare of construction workers in Delhi.

As of October 2023, the DBOCWWB has registered over 1.5 million construction workers.

The board has been proactive in ensuring that workers are aware of their rights and benefits under various welfare schemes.

The Family Pension Scheme is one of several initiatives aimed at improving the socio-economic conditions of construction workers and their families.

The scheme has been well-received by the beneficiaries.

Feedback from families indicates that the pension has significantly alleviated financial stress.

The DBOCWWB regularly conducts awareness programs to inform workers about the Family Pension Scheme and other benefits.

The board also collaborates with various NGOs and community organizations to reach out to workers.

The Family Pension Scheme is a crucial component of the Delhi Government's commitment to worker welfare.

It reflects the government's recognition of the risks associated with construction work.

The scheme also aims to promote a sense of security among workers and their families.

In addition to the Family Pension Scheme, the DBOCWWB offers various other welfare schemes.

These include health insurance, scholarships for children, and maternity benefits.

The Family Pension Scheme is funded through the contributions made by construction workers to the welfare fund.

The fund is managed by the DBOCWWB and is utilized for various welfare initiatives.

The board ensures transparency in the utilization of funds.

Regular audits are conducted to maintain accountability.

The Family Pension Scheme is a testament to the government's efforts to provide social security to vulnerable sections of society.

It aims to create a more equitable society where families are not left destitute due to the loss of a breadwinner.

The scheme is part of a larger framework of social security measures being implemented across India.

The DBOCWWB continues to evolve its programs based on the needs of the workers.

The Family Pension Scheme has been instrumental in providing a financial cushion to families in distress.

As of now, the scheme has disbursed pensions to thousands of eligible families.

The DBOCWWB is committed to enhancing the benefits of the Family Pension Scheme in the future.

The board is exploring options to increase the pension amount based on inflation and cost of living adjustments.

The Family Pension Scheme is an essential lifeline for many families in the construction sector.

It underscores the importance of social security in protecting the rights and welfare of workers.

The DBOCWWB remains dedicated to ensuring that all eligible families receive the benefits they are entitled to.

The Family Pension Scheme is a crucial step towards building a more secure future for the families of construction workers in Delhi.
